newsitem.title: EGYPT: Mercedes-Benz to make cars in Egypt by November.
newsitem.headline: Mercedes-Benz to make cars in Egypt by November.

text.p: Daimler-Benz AG will start assembling luxury cars in Egypt in November at a new $45 million plant majority-owned by National Automotive Co., a longstanding local Mercedes-Benz dealer.

The plant at Sixth of October City, in the desert west of Cairo, will start production at a rate of 2,500 Mercedes-Benz E-200s a year, executives of Daimler-Benz and National Automotive told a presentation Tuesday night.

Industry sources said the cars will sell at a lower price than that of an equivalent imported model, on which the tariff rate is higher than for the complete assembly kits the plant will import from Germany.

National Automotive, a private company dominated by family interests, holds a 72 percent stake in the new joint venture and Daimler-Benz holds 26 percent. Two percent is owned by National International Trade, another private firm.
